comment: With no title, the name is the id.
CommonMark in STAC; kept as written.

scientific extension: the DOI of the data, as a PropertyValue, is the identifier and its https://doi.org/ URL the @id. A DOI that is also one of sci:publications is the paper's, and is not used. With no DOI the identifier is the Collection id and the @id its self link.
themes extension: each concept a DefinedTerm in its scheme.
A DefinedTerm in the set 'STAC platform'.
A DefinedTerm in the set 'STAC constellation'.
A DefinedTerm in the set 'STAC instruments'.
An SPDX id (matched ignoring case and punctuation) as its spdx.org page. proprietary, other and various name no licence: the license links do.
Any other licence value, as text: 'License: <value>'.
A CreativeWork at the link's href. With no licence and no licence link, schema:license is the OGC nil URI.
Google Earth Engine catalog's terms of use.
Each provider with role producer an Organization, in the creator @list in provider order.
A provider with role host is an Organization provider.
A provider with role licensor or processor is a schema:Role contributor with that roleName.
contacts extension: a schema:Role pointOfContact, a Person (with affiliation) or an Organization, with the first email and phone.
With none, dateModified is the sentinel 1900-01-01.
version extension.
Each WGS 84 box (the first the whole extent, the others its parts; a repeat is dropped) as a Place with a GeoShape box (S W N E). A 3D box loses its heights.
Each interval as ISO 8601 start/end, an open end as '..'; an instant when start and end are equal. [null, null] is dropped.

An asset with no roles, or a role data, archive, default, visual, overview, stac-items or collection-mirror, is a DataDownload: href its contentUrl, type its encodingFormat, file:size its contentSize.
Other assets (thumbnail, metadata, documentation, style ...) are LinkRoles whose linkRelationship is the first role.
An HTML alternate (a STAC Browser or publisher page) is the landing page. Else the self link.

Each link with one of these relations as a LinkRole, its relation the linkRelationship. Relative hrefs are resolved against the self link. root, parent, child, item and the OGC API relations (queryables, sortables) are navigation, not converted.
scientific extension: each publication a CreativeWork, its citation the description and its DOI the identifier.

item_assets, the other summaries (bands, gsd, projection, ...), stac_extensions, crs and the table extension's columns are not converted.
